features:
Features

Includes 3 fan-favorite fruit snacks: Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers combined in one box.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free: Suitable for gluten-sensitive individuals and vegetarians.

Excellent Source of Vitamin C: Each pouch contains a healthy boost of daily vitamin C.

No Artificial Flavors: Made without synthetic flavor additives for a more natural taste.

Kosher Certified: Meets kosher dietary standards.

8 Individually Wrapped Pouches: Convenient, portion-controlled packs perfect for on-the-go snacking. 

Benefits

Fun Variety for Everyone: Offers multiple textures and fruity formats, keeping snack time exciting for kids and adults.

Snack Smart: Vitamin C enrichment and no artificial flavors provide a better-for-you snack option.

Perfect for On-the-Go: Portable and mess-free for lunchboxes, road trips, or quick breaks.

Inclusive & Allergy-Friendly: Free from gluten and gelatin, making it accessible for more dietary needs.

Trusted Brand Quality: Backed by the consistency and reliability of Betty Crocker.

Easy to Share: Great for school, parties, or gifting — no repackaging needed.
ingredients: Corn Syrup, Sugar, Pear Puree, Maltodextrin, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil. Contains 2% or less of: Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Monoglycerides, Fruit Pectin, Malic Acid, Vitamin C (ascorbic acid), Natural Flavor, Color (red 40, yellows 5 & 6, blue 1).
